title: Tech Note: 4D Pop: Developer Components
author: Jesse Pina, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: 4D Pop palette window and its XML-based (4DPop.xml) tool-plugin architecture
Design-mode developer productivity components: Bookmarks, Color Chart, Commands lookup, Constants Editor, Image Buddy, Rulers, SqlSchemas, XLIFF editor
4D v11 SQL component architecture enhancements enabling easy component installation
Migration Assistants (Constants, Macros, Shortcuts) for pre-v11 SQL databases

historical_commentary.text: 4D Pop was a community-extensible palette of Design-Mode developer productivity tools (bookmarks, color picker, command finder, constants/XLIFF editors, SQL schema editor, etc.) built on 4D v11 SQL's then-new, simplified component architecture. Nearly everything described here is tied to the classic binary Design Mode IDE, its resource-file-based (rsrc) constants, and its XLIFF-based string localization workflow, all of which were fundamentally reworked when 4D moved to Project Mode (text-based .4DProject, v17+, 2018) with a modern built-in code editor, integrated command/method search, and JSON-based settings and localization. 4D Pop itself and most of its listed components are no longer relevant to a current 4D IDE, though the general idea of developer productivity tooling persists in 4D's built-in tooling today.
related_updates: Project mode (4D v17+, 2018) replaced Design Mode's binary component/constants/XLIFF architecture that 4D Pop's tools targeted
The current 4D IDE (Explorer, code editor) now natively provides command search, quick access, and other productivity features 4D Pop's components once supplied as third-party add-ons
